content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early cycles and underperform in late cycles.", "Sentiment spikes correlate with forecast overshoots, especially when positive sentiment persists.", "Model bias toward upward trends is evident when sentiment remains bullish despite price corrections.", "Forecast lags often occur when sentiment shifts from bullish to neutral or bearish.", "Mean-reversion patterns emerge after sustained bullish sentiment, triggering model corrections.", "Overshoots are more frequent when sentiment is high and historical price volatility is elevated.", "Models fail to capture sentiment-driven volatility in late cycles, leading to underestimation of price drops.", "Sentiment decay precedes forecast collapse, indicating model sensitivity to sentiment reversal."]}
